shortBio: Automation Architect building intelligent testing systems and exploring Agentic AI.
fullBio:
For over a decade, I've helped teams build better software by treating quality as an engineering discipline rather than a testing phase. My journey started with manual testing and evolved into designing scalable automation frameworks, leading engineering teams, and now exploring how AI is transforming software quality.

Today, I work at the intersection of Quality Engineering, AI, and Developer Productivity — building intelligent testing workflows using LLMs, RAG, LangChain, Playwright, and modern automation frameworks. My focus isn't just automating tests; it's reducing engineering effort, improving confidence, and enabling teams to ship faster.

I'm particularly interested in: AI-powered Test Automation, Agentic AI for Quality Engineering, LLM Evaluation & Guardrails, RAG & MCP, Shift Left Engineering, and Engineering Productivity through AI. Beyond technology, I mentor engineers, lead cross-functional initiatives, and foster a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility.

capabilities: Agentic AI for Quality Engineering — autonomous testing workflows

capabilities: Design E2E frameworks with Playwright and Selenium
Build API testing with REST Assured and Postman
Shift Left quality — test earlier, fail cheaper

whatIdo.title: Development & Cloud
capabilities: Spring Boot, Node.js, React for full-stack delivery
Docker, Kubernetes, Azure for cloud infrastructure
Jenkins, GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines

philosophy: I believe quality starts long before execution — whether it's Shift Left principles, AI-assisted workflows, or building tools that eliminate repetitive work. The goal is always the same: help engineers spend less time on manual effort and more time solving meaningful problems.
